title: A Giant Crab Climbs Trees to Hunt Sleeping Seabirds

scenes.text: A crab climbed a tree and killed a sleeping bird.
It's the coconut crab, the largest land invertebrate on Earth.
Its legs span over a meter, and it weighs over four kilos.
In 2016, a biologist filmed one on a remote island.
The crab grabbed a roosting seabird at night.
Its claw broke the bird's bones, and it dragged it to the ground.
Other crabs smelled blood and joined in.
A crab that hunts birds. Watch it again.

description:
A crab climbed a tree and killed a sleeping bird.
The coconut crab is the largest land invertebrate on Earth, with a leg span over a meter. A biologist filmed the attack in the Chagos Islands.
Would you swim in the ocean knowing crabs like this exist?
first_comment: Bonus: scientists had suspected for years that coconut crabs hunt birds. This was the first time anyone filmed it. What else are we missing?
